54. MAINTENANCE ALLOWANCE FOR PERSONS AFFECTED 
WITH MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY 
 
 
 
1 
Gist of the Scheme 
Maintenance allowance is given at the rate of    
Rs.1,500/- per month to the person affected with 
muscular dystrophy.  The allowance is sent through 
ECS to their accounts directly from Treasury. 
2 
Eligibility Criteria 
Persons should be affected with muscular dystrophy and 
percentage of disability 40% and above. 
3 
Whether the prescribed 
application form is 
available 
Yes. Prescribed format is available with District 
Differently Abled Welfare Officer. 
4 
Certificates to be furnished 
National identity card for differently abled, family card, 
Photo and Bank account details. 
5 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be 
submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. 
6 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Special Officer,  
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
